card.title: One Missing Step
card.instruction: Treat the smallest skipped step as the beginning of systemic collapse. Escalate safeguards, documentation, and oversight before allowing anything to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You skipped item six on the kettle checklist.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Item six says check that the lid is closed. It's closed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But we can't prove you checked it before item seven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First we need a procedure for interrupted kettle procedures.

mechanism: A treats the unchecked sequence as invalidating the kettle process and makes restarting require another authorized procedure.
confusable: Unlike ordinary personal fear of failure, A must interpret the small omission as threatening the system's protection and expand oversight.
comparison: The kettle alternative regulates interruption and restart; the visitor alternative regulates who can verify the amendment witness.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
